name: Marigold Intrinsic Lighting (Delight)
description: Splits the source image into albedo, diffuse shading and a non-diffuse residual. Albedo is the relightable surface colour; shading and residual are preserved as diagnostic maps for inspection, not misfiled as AO or emission.
notes: IID lighting returns albedo / diffuse shading / non-diffuse residual concatenated on the BATCH dimension. Only albedo is a direct runtime material input. Diffuse shading is illumination, not ambient occlusion; residual contains mixed non-diffuse lighting such as specular highlights and direct light sources, not literal emission. Both diagnostic maps are stored and previewable so the decomposition remains auditable.
